Chrome1.Chrome Series 1: Release: August 2013  |  Base checklist: SAME as OS1 tab (same names/numbers, reprinted on chrome stock)

Base set (110 cards) = OS1's 82 cards reprinted on chrome stock with the SAME names/numbers as the OS1 tab, plus 14 new 'Lost GPK' characters (L1-L14) that never made the original 1985 cut. Also: 41 Concept Sketch inserts (John Pound pencil art, 1:6 packs), C-Name short prints (3rd name for select characters), multiple Refractor parallels, Superfractors, printing plates, and John Pound autographs.

Chrome2.Chrome Series 2: Release: 2014  |  Base checklist: SAME as OS2 tab (same names/numbers, reprinted on chrome stock)

Base set = OS2's 84 cards reprinted on chrome stock with the same names/numbers as the OS2 tab, plus a 'Returning GPK' subset reusing characters previously seen in the Flashback series (rather than brand-new 'Lost' characters). Also: a full Pencil Art insert set (John Pound rough sketches of all 42 OS2 characters), C-Name short prints, Gold Refractors, X-Fractors, and other parallel tiers.

Chrome3.Chrome Series 3: Release: 2022  |  Base checklist: SAME as OS3 tab (same names/numbers, reprinted on chrome stock)

Base set = OS3's 82 cards reprinted on chrome stock with the same names/numbers as the OS3 tab. All-new addition: 18 brand-new cards featuring 9 new characters (art by Brent Engstrom, Joe Simko, David Gross, Smokin' Joe McWilliams), plus 20 artist autograph cards, C-Name short prints, and multiple Refractor/parallel tiers (Green, Purple, Prism, etc.).

Chrome4.Chrome Series 4: Release: 2021 (GPK Goes On Vacation)  |  Base checklist: SAME as OS4 tab (same names/numbers, reprinted on chrome stock)

Base set = OS4's 84 cards reprinted on chrome stock with the same names/numbers as the OS4 tab, plus new bonus characters and an extensive parallel run (Refractor, Atomic, Green/Yellow/Purple/Prism/X-Fractor, Black, Orange, Gold Refractors, etc.).

Chrome5.Chrome Series 5: Release: December 2021/January 2022  |  Base checklist: SAME as OS5 tab (same names/numbers, reprinted on chrome stock)

Base set = OS5's 80 cards reprinted on chrome stock with the same names/numbers as the OS5 tab, plus 20 new cards featuring 10 new characters (art by Brent Engstrom, Joe Simko, Joe McWilliams, Neil Camera, David Gross), numbered continuing from 207-216 rather than an 'AN_' prefix. Also: a 'No Blue-Ink' chase parallel referencing a famous 1986 production error, 22 artist autographs, and the standard Refractor parallel tiers.

Chrome6.Chrome Series 6: Release: 2023  |  Base checklist: SAME as OS6 tab (same names/numbers, reprinted on chrome stock)

Base set = OS6's 88 cards reprinted on chrome stock with the same names/numbers as the OS6 tab. Includes new bonus characters, artist autographs, Color Error chase cards (one per 'A' card), and Sapphire Edition parallels.

Chrome7.Chrome Series 7: Release: February 2025  |  Base checklist: SAME as OS7 tab (same names/numbers, reprinted on chrome stock)

Base set (100 cards) = OS7's names/numbers as the OS7 tab, reimagined with new artwork, plus a 'Where Are They Now?' insert subset updating OS7 characters for today, hobby-exclusive C-Name variations (3rd names), Original 1/1 artist sketch cards, Superfractor parallels (1/1), and rare artist autographs.

Flashback1.Flashback Series 1: Release: 2010  |  Base checklist: remixes characters from OS1-OS8 (see those tabs for full names) — NOT a straight 1:1 reprint of a single series

Base set draws characters from Original Series 1 through OS8 (not a straight reprint of one series — a curated remix across the early OS run), printed with the line's first-ever parallel border colors/patterns. Card backs 2a-23b reproduce the 1986 Giant Postcards #1-12 (missing #9 and #12 backs). Two separate checklists exist — one for 'a' cards, one for 'b' cards. Also includes a 'Where Are They Now?' insert subset.

Flashback2.Flashback Series 2: Release: 2011  |  Base checklist: remixes characters from OS1-OS9 (see those tabs for full names) — NOT a straight 1:1 reprint of a single series

Base set draws characters from Original Series 1 through OS9, with a smaller checkered border than FB1. Card backs are 'Fakebook' (Facebook-parody) profiles written by artist Joe Simko and his wife June. Known error: cards 14a/14b show Off-The-Wall PAUL and ZACH Plaque artwork but are labeled Sewer SUE / MICHELLE Muck. Cards 33a/33b (Dangling DOLLY / Surreal NEAL) are the only characters to appear in both FB1 and FB2.

Flashback3.Flashback Series 3: Release: November 2011  |  Base checklist: remixes characters from OS1-OS15 (see those tabs for full names) — NOT a straight 1:1 reprint of a single series

Base set draws characters from Original Series 1 through OS15 — the widest span of any Flashback set — with noticeably better print quality than FB1/FB2, and the checkerboard border dropped (yellow accents remain). Backs mix 'Fakebook' profiles (stickers 1a-18b) with the remaining 1986 Giant Postcard images (stickers 41a-46b = Postcards #12-15, minus the #14 back). Also includes: 4 'Lost' kids, a 'Where Are They Now?' (WatN) subset, 5 3D cards, 10 Adam-Mania cards, artist sketch cards, and parallels.
